analysis:
Both supplied units are head_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 2465-3234). The PR changes in this file are documentation only: a date bump at line 3, a note about ClusterTensorParallelChoice.fastest (Gemma 4) near line 3635, and a large new Gemma 4 tensor-parallel section after line 4037. The new Gemma 4 section is not in the supplied units, only in a truncated patch excerpt. The excerpt lines are unchanged context and do not add or alter any code, so no runtime behavior or control changes.

I reviewed the visible content against the threat model. It covers MiMo native media ingest and decode accounting, cluster member registration, the two-Mac cluster data plane and lane handling, and the invariants and failure-mode tables. Descriptions of fail-closed behavior include these:
- Media caps, and refusals of unsupported layouts.
- Client-error mapping that stays content-free.
- Refusal logs that never carry request text (invariant 10).
- No disk writes for the in-memory video asset.
- Cluster data plane encryption and authentication.
- Sanitized environment for the local-owner child.

These are consistent with T-008, T-041, T-050 and TB-007. The only accessible cache-related statements are that tenant partitions and cache salt are preserved, and that media is noncacheable. These do not weaken the T-041 posture.

No security regression, new attack surface or invalidated assumption was identified in the visible text. The newly added Gemma 4 tensor-parallel section (head lines 4037-4240) and the line 3635 change were not supplied as numbered source. They may touch the cluster trust boundary (peer control and data plane) and should be checked in whichever batch carries them. Backend and coordinator contracts referenced externally were not provided, and no claim is made about them.
